project_type: npm-workspaces TypeScript monorepo: @mlb/shared (domain types + seed), @mlb/backend (Lambda handlers, MLB client, predict model, Bedrock narrative), @mlb/frontend (Vite React SPA), @mlb/infra (AWS CDK). Deployed MLB postseason summary site.
build_system: npm workspaces. Node 22 local toolchain (code must stay Node 20 compatible for Lambda). npm is NOT on PATH by default - prefix commands with PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" (node alone is on PATH at /usr/local/bin/node).
test_framework: Vitest, colocated *.test.ts (unit) and *.property.test.ts (fast-check). Frontend React tests via jsdom + @testing-library. Playwright e2e in frontend/e2e/*.spec.ts. AWS SDK and MLB API are mocked; no live calls.
build_command: PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm run build  (ordered shared -> backend -> frontend -> infra)
test_command: PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm test  (all workspaces). E2E: npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend (may need: npx playwright install chromium once). Synth: npm run synth.
verification_instructions: 1) npm run build. 2) npm test. 3) npm run synth (cdk synth, no AWS). 4) npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend (headless chromium --no-sandbox). All must stay green. Do NOT run cdk deploy or live Bedrock InvokeModel; mock the invoker in tests.

key_patterns: Bedrock call isolated behind BedrockInvoker interface (mockable) with a deterministic templated fallback on any error. PredictionResponse is a discriminated union (mode: prediction|results|upcoming), all HTTP 200. getPrediction returns results-only for past seasons and finished series. Optional request params are threaded UI -> api -> handler -> service -> callee and parsed leniently (never 400 on a missing/invalid optional, e.g. parseAccuracy returns undefined so default applies). Shared numeric contracts (accuracy bounds) live in @mlb/shared and are consumed by both model and slider. Frontend i18n is a lightweight in-repo context (DEFAULT_LANG='ja', localStorage key mlb.lang) with a flat MESSAGES[Lang][MessageKey] dict and a t() interpolator; unknown team ids render localized TBD placeholder ('TBD (#id)' / '未定 (#id)').
